description: This file contains test functions for aggregating workflow execution statuses, including creating test data and verifying the correctness of the Aggregates executions function in various scenarios.

methods.name: makeExecution
methods.description: Helper function to create a WorkflowExecution object with specified status, start and completion times, and parent status.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_AllSucceeded
methods.description: Test to verify aggregation when all executions have succeeded.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_RunningOverridesSuccess
methods.description: Test to verify that a running execution overrides successful statuses, indicating ongoing activity.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_PrioritisesFailures
methods.description: Test to verify that failure statuses are prioritized correctly during aggregation.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_QueuedOnly
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when only queued executions are present.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_TimeoutBeatsCancelled
methods.description: Test to ensure timeout status takes precedence over cancellation.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_PendingStepKeepsWorkflowRunning
methods.description: Test to check that pending steps keep the overall workflow status as running.

methods.name: TestAggregateExecutions_RootSuccessOverridesFailedChildren
methods.description: Test that a successful root execution overrides failures in child executions.
